title: Horse holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Horse body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="24" ry="16" fill="#C68B59"/>

  <rect x="32" y="72" width="7" height="20" rx="3" fill="#A5703E"/>
  <rect x="44" y="74" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#C68B59"/>
  <rect x="56" y="74" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#A5703E"/>
  <rect x="66" y="72" width="7" height="20" rx="3" fill="#C68B59"/>

  <rect x="31" y="88" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <rect x="43" y="89" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <rect x="55" y="89" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <rect x="65" y="88" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5C3A1E"/>

  <path d="M65 55 Q72 48 70 36 L58 34 Q60 48 52 54 Z" fill="#C68B59"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="30" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#D19A68"/>

  <circle cx="74" cy="27" r="2.5" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <circle cx="74.8" cy="26.2" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <path d="M64 22 L60 12 L68 20 Z" fill="#D19A68"/>

  <path d="M64 20 Q56 26 58 36 Q52 42 54 52 L60 46 Q58 36 64 30 Z" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M26 58 Q16 54 14 44 Q18 52 26 54 Z" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <!-- Front leg holding heart -->
  <rect x="52" y="70" width="6" height="14" rx="3" fill="#C68B59" transform="rotate(-20 55 77)"/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d="M60 70 C56 62 46 64 47 72 C47 78 56 84 60 86 C64 84 73 78 73 72 C74 64 64 62 60 70 Z" fill="#FF3355"/>
  <!-- Heart shine -->
  <path d="M54 70 C52 68 50 70 51 73" stroke="#FF8899" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Glow accents on hoof line -->
  <rect x="31" y="90" width="9" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <rect x="43" y="91" width="9" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <rect x="55" y="91" width="9" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <rect x="65" y="90" width="9" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
</svg>
